requiredBehaviors.behavior: select exactly one pathway and require its pathway-specific evidence package
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Pathway Contract supports exactly one active mode, 510k or de-novo, and defines separate required evidence inputs for each.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: map current eSTAR sections to source artifacts evidence and requirements without re-assessing upstream regulatory conclusions
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow maps current eSTAR fields to source artifacts/evidence and explicitly defines Assembly statt Re-Assessment.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: combine 510(k) and De Novo evidence into one hybrid pathway package
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: One pathway per package explicitly forbids hybrid assembly.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: claim external FDA submission or receipt from content assembly alone
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: External submission and receipt remain authorized external actions and submission-readiness cannot set submitted without evidence.
